+--
+-- One row per (cv, label). Lets the library filter saved CVs by a short
+-- user-defined label. Tag labels are user content but carry no CV body, so
+-- they are listable alongside the content-free summary columns.

+create table public.cv_tags (

+  cv_id      uuid        not null references public.cvs (id) on delete cascade,
+  user_id    uuid        not null references auth.users (id) on delete cascade,

+ * Saved-CV tag data access.
+ *
+ * Same shape as `cv-repository`: thin typed queries, no HTTP, no envelope. Owner
+ * identity is supplied by the caller from the verified `auth.getUser()` id and
+ * applied to every query. Functions throw on DB error; the route maps to buckets.

+  cvId: string;
+  label: string;

+  id: string;
+  cv_id: string;
+  label: string;
+}

+  return { id: row.id, cvId: row.cv_id, label: row.label };

+    throw error;
+  }
+  return data.map(mapTag);
